audit.recompute_scope: the eligibility counts and seed ids come from the eligibility pass, not from the raw rows; the oracle arm's per-row bits are recomputable from the retained per-row observed residuals; the learned arm's per-row bits are recomputable only with the retained model (hash-pinned in training.model_state_sha256); the heuristic arm's per-row bits are recomputable from the retained observation draws (observation_seed and permutation are stored per row) via the certified feature machinery, not from the raw rows alone; this block recomputes the aggregation from the retained raw rows

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.7) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle at the held-out fraction 0.6
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.6) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle at the held-out fraction 0.8
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.8) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the non-learned grid-mean log1p profile heuristic at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_heur(seed, 0.7) with d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.method: one-sided Student-t lower bounds with Bonferroni correction; the generator seed is the inference unit

baselines.heuristic: descriptive non-learned heuristic: argmin of the grid-mean log1p profile (the profile-shape comparator of H4)
baselines.oracle: polluted argmin observed-residual oracle: argmin of the operating-fraction profile column (polluted at every fraction — no clean column exists)

design.declared_caveat: the comparison is asymmetric by design: the learned router integrates the full degraded profile; the oracle reads only one polluted column (the operating fraction). The heuristic baseline in H4 is the profile-shape non-learned comparator. Demo-scale numbers are not evidence.
design.eligibility_rule: the instance builds and the clean audit on the UNDEGRADED instance passes (true misfit <= 1e-9, every decoy > 1e-9); deterministic per seed and never entering features
design.estimand: per (seed, fraction) accuracies over R=4 shared replicates; paired differences d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc and d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc
design.feature: the 18-dim no-anchor degradation-profile feature vector exactly as universa.router_v2.no_anchor_candidate_features computes it: log1p observed misfit at the 8 grid points under the row's observation draw, 7 first-difference slopes, and 3 masked structural dims (V', kept edge count, masked cycle nullity)
design.observation_degradation: universa.partial.ObservationModel with mask_fraction = 0.25 (edge columns removed) AND sign corruption at every grid point; the profile grid 0.2..0.9 by 0.1 excludes 0.0 — no clean column exists anywhere (the no-anchor regime)
design.permutation: per (seed, fraction) from subseed(seed, 'router-v2-permutation', f'{fraction:.6f}'), shared across the row's replicates, with audited labels
design.replicate_subseed: subseed(seed, 'sealed-replicate', str(fraction), str(replicate_index)) per data row, driving BOTH the mask draw and the nested corruption draws; the same observation_seed feeds all arms within a row (paired)
design.task_family: graph-quotient switch instances via universa.budgets.make_budget_instance(num_vertices=8, num_edges=14, num_classes=6, num_decoys=3); K=4 candidates, true target at index 0 pre-permutation
design.train_replicates: one replicate (index 0) per train (seed, fraction); 800 rows

training.standardization: input mean/std measured on the train block only
training.validation_monitor: the train block itself; the frozen design defines no validation split
